title: Latest Price — returns the most recent closing price and 1-day change for a tick
description:
Latest Price — returns the most recent closing price and 1-day change for a ticker. Cheapest endpoint; ideal for quick price checks before or after pattern analysis.

HOW TO CALL:
  POST /get_latest_price?ticker=AAPL

PARAMETERS:
  ticker  — asset symbol (e.g. AAPL, BTC-USD, SPY)

RESPONSE: { ticker, date, close, change_pct }

_signals.x_guidance:
market2000.xyz — The intelligence layer for the agentic economy. Pattern intelligence + market data APIs, pay-per-call via x402 on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). All parameters are URL query strings on POST requests — no request body is needed. Data for any ticker is auto-fetched from yfinance on first request.
